title: Zig: Arithmetic
description: Perform basic arithmetic operations in Zig.

steps.title: Arithmetic Operations
steps.description: Declare const a: i32 = 15, b: i32 = 4. Compute and print a + b, a - b, a * b, a / b, and @mod(a, b) for remainder.

verification.failureMessage: Print sum, difference, product, quotient, and remainder
